# RepairRange

> Australian phone, tablet and smartwatch repair cost guide. Independently researched, transparent pricing for screen, battery, charging port, water damage and software repairs, plus repair-vs-replace guidance, screen quality tiers, and Australian consumer repair rights. Repairs performed by Mayfield Phone Repair, Newcastle NSW.

## Cost guides
- [All repair costs by model](https://repairrange.io/repair/phone-repair-costs-australia.html): screen, battery, port and water damage pricing for iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, iPad and Samsung Galaxy Tab models
- [Apple](https://repairrange.io/brands/apple.html): iPhone, iPad and MacBook repair costs
- [Samsung](https://repairrange.io/brands/samsung.html): Galaxy S, A, Z-series phones
- [Samsung Tablets](https://repairrange.io/brands/samsung-tab.html): Galaxy Tab A and S series
- [Google](https://repairrange.io/brands/google.html): Pixel repair costs
- [Repair calculator](https://repairrange.io/calculator.html): estimate your repair cost
